title: Save the active PCB as ASCII without changing its state
summary: Saves a copy of the active PCB in the PCB ASCII File format with DoFileSave inside BeginRecoverySave/EndRecoverySave and restores the document's file name, Modified flag and date; closes the save's message box from a background thread.
phrasings: export a board as ASCII PcbDoc
save a copy of a document without renaming it
save a PCB in another file format
keep the modified flag after saving

commands.name: SaveAsAscii
commands.description: Save a copy of the PCB as ASCII
commands.params: Out=<folder or .PcbDoc file> (default temp folder)|AutoDismiss=false (optional)|DialogTitle=<title> (default Information)

commands.name: DocumentState
commands.description: Show the PCB document's file name, Modified flag and date

commands.name: SetModified
commands.description: Set the PCB document's Modified flag (test setup)
